subject.title: feat: show OpenClaw sessions in Codex

question: Should OpenClaw ship the native Codex sidebar collection now even though that entrypoint is experimental and cannot be independently validated in the public Codex source?
rationale: Implementation correctness can be reviewed, but accepting a private or experimental host contract and its future compatibility burden requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Ship after live proof
options.body: Accept the experimental collection after the stacked MCP profile lands and an exact-head real Codex install proves both native and fallback session workflows.

options.title: Wait for stable Codex support
options.body: Hold this bundle until Codex publishes a stable collection entrypoint and compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Ship after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the experimental collection after the stacked MCP profile lands and an exact-head real Codex install proves both native and fallback session workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history and the canonical feature discussion connect this person most directly to the Codex product-surface decision.
